title: The Pink Sock
lines: Meg dips a pink sock in the sink.
Mom thinks, then gets a long rod.
Tug, tug, tug at the pink sock.
Mom tells Meg to hang it up.

questions.ask: What happens to the sock in the sink?
questions.listenFor: It sinks. If they say "it got wet," ask "and then what did it do?" to get them back to the word sinks.

questions.ask: What does Mom use to get the sock back?
questions.listenFor: A long rod. This is stated in the story, so have them reread that line instead of telling them.

questions.ask: What do you think Meg should do next time? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any sensible plan is fine. You are listening for a because, such as "hang it up, because it sank last time."
